description: Canonical schema for salmon-run plan files. Routing headers are current-state metadata. PondLog entries are the append-only history of actions performed on a plan.

Status.description: Current pond status. Updated on every transition.

Scope.description: One-line description of the plan's responsibility.

Challenge.description: Model tier or override for routing (Flash, Daily, Complex, Frontier, Local).

DependsOn.description: Comma-separated list of plan IDs that must reach Complete before this plan enters Code.

Children.description: Comma-separated list of child plan IDs for Project pond decomposition.

ProjectId.description: Parent project plan ID, if this plan is a child of a Project.

EstimatedImplementationTokens.description: Estimated coding workload for one session plan. Child plans must be between 1 and 100000.

SessionTokenCeiling.description: Hard implementation-token ceiling applied while decomposing a project.

ReviewSummary.description: Concise explanation of the review result.

ReviewFeedbackFile.description: Filename of the detailed review feedback artifact.

ReviewedPlan.description: Plan filename whose implementation was reviewed.

Investigated.description: Concise explanation of the investigation result.

Blocked.description: Whether this plan is currently blocked waiting on feedback.

BlockedReason.description: Concise reason this plan is blocked.

WaitingFor.description: Filename of the feedback plan this blocked plan is waiting on.

PlanType.description: Kind of plan (main, feedback, investigation, etc.).

ParentPlan.description: Filename of the parent plan this feedback plan was derived from.

FailedStage.description: Pond in which the parent plan failed, prompting this feedback.

DecisionRequired.description: Whether a human decision is required before this plan may proceed.

claim.description: An agent or operator claimed the plan for work.

prepare.description: The plan was prepared for execution (lane/stream selected, model routed).

lock.description: An exclusive lock was acquired on the plan for an execution attempt.

route.description: A model/profile was selected for the plan.

spawn.description: An executor process was started for the plan.

implement.description: The Code pond produced an implementation.

review.description: The Review pond reviewed the implementation.

audit.description: The Audit pond audited the plan for public-safety issues.

qa.description: The QA pond verified quality gates.

external-complete.description: An external agent executor completed a plan.

external-fail.description: An external agent executor failed to complete a plan.

external-timeout.description: An external agent executor was stopped because it exceeded its time budget.

fail.description: The plan moved to Failed (final failure).

retry.description: The plan was retried and moved back to an earlier pond.

feedback.description: A non-transient failure created a feedback plan for the Coder.

decision-required.description: The plan was moved to Intake because a human decision is required.

created.description: A new feedback plan was created in the Code queue.

investigate.description: The Investigate pond investigated a recurring failure pattern and produced a fix or root-cause summary.

override.description: A routing or execution value was overridden (preserved as history, not just current state).

commit.description: The task repo or target repo was committed after a transition.

push.description: The task repo or target repo was pushed after a commit.
